qobuz_provider.label: Qobuz account
qobuz_provider.description: The Qobuz music provider whose account the devices join. The devices play through it and appear in the Qobuz apps of this account.

connected_players.label: [%key:common::config_entries::connected_players::label%]
connected_players.description: The Music Assistant players to expose via Qobuz Connect. Every selected player appears as its own device in the Qobuz apps. Leave empty to keep the plugin idle.

publish_name_template.label: [%key:common::config_entries::publish_name_template::label%]
publish_name_template.description: How each device shown in the Qobuz apps is named, based on the connected player's name.
